architecture.mechanism: Real-time deep-learning-based computer vision using YOLO models deployed at the edge for continuous inspection and anomaly detection
architecture.intervention: Integrate a real-time edge-deployed YOLO-based computer vision system with high-speed imaging sensors inside the transmission housing to continuously monitor gear engagement, clutch pack alignment, and hydraulic actuator motion, enabling predictive micro-adjustments to shift timing and pressure before hesitation or clunking occurs
architecture.expected_effect: Smooth gear shifts without hesitation or clunking, maintenance of full engine power delivery, and prevention of premature transmission failure across the vehicle service life through real-time visual closed-loop control
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the transmission on a dynamometer through 10,000 consecutive shift cycles under variable load while measuring shift completion time variance and peak driveline shock torque; if shift time variance exceeds 50 milliseconds or peak shock torque exceeds baseline thresholds, the intervention fails
